# Copilot Instructions — StudyLife AI

The binding rules for this repository live in [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) in the repository
root. Read that file and follow it; nothing here overrides it.

This file previously held a second, verbatim copy of those rules. Two copies drift apart,
and the equivalent file in the sister repository proved it: it ended up describing tools
and a milestone range that its own stated source of truth had already ruled out. One file
cannot disagree with itself.
